Subject: Novapay — Post-demo recap & next steps

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a few asks so we can put together an accurate invoice estimate:

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: customer support automation + incoming payments triage (priority flows)
- Expected concurrency: light (mostly async) with occasional spikes around payroll runs
- Models: want a cost-forward plan using an open 13B or opt-quantized 70B variant for higher-quality flows

Data points we discussed I still need (please reply inline):
1) Monthly token volume (avg) and peak month estimate
2) Target price /1M tokens or budget range you’re aiming for (helps us recommend reserved vs. on-demand)
3) Any compliance requirements that would push you to Private or Dedicated (SOC2, VPC, on-prem)

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll share a preliminary cost model and an invoice-style estimate that shows both On-demand and Reserved (1yr) options plus a quick sensitivity table for token volume and target $/1M.
- Marissa will include network/egress and support line items where relevant.

If you can send the numbers for (1) and (2) by EOD Wed we’ll turn around the model by Thu.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0134

Thanks Sean — great demo. Answers below:

1) Token volumes:
- Baseline (projected steady-state): ~50M tokens/month
- Core growth scenario (12mo): 150M tokens/month
- Peak (one-off payroll month spikes): up to 250M tokens in a month

2) Budget / target unit economics:
- Our finance team is targeting ~$1,000 per 1M tokens as the maximum acceptable unit cost for production workloads (we realize this is negotiable with commit).
- Rough annual budget for inference (op-ex): $400k–$900k depending on adoption (this guides whether Reserved + burst or Hosted makes sense)

3) Compliance: SOC 2 is required; VPC peering preferred but not strictly required for MVP. We’d like to understand the incremental cost to move to Dedicated or Private.

Happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Subject: Novapay — Invoice estimate & cost model (v1)

Alyssa — thanks for the numbers. Attached are three artifacts: novapay-cost-model-v1.xlsx (detailed worksheet), novapay-invoice-estimate.pdf (one-page invoice-style view), and redwood-pricing-calculator.csv (CSV you can plug into your own models). Links also in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovapayCostModel

High level summary from the model (all numbers monthly unless noted):
- Assumptions: baseline model Redwood-13B-quant (medium quality) and Redwood-70B-quant for high-quality flows; on-demand GPU pricing + reserved discount scenarios included.
- 50M tokens/month (baseline):
  * On-demand mix: estimated $46,200 / month (~$924 per 1M tokens)
  * 1-yr reserved (committed 50M mo): estimated $37,500 / month (~$750 per 1M tokens)
- 150M tokens/month (growth):
  * On-demand: estimated $132,000 / month (~$880 per 1M tokens with quantity discount applied)
  * 1-yr reserved (tiered): estimated $98,500 / month (~$657 per 1M tokens)
- Peak 250M tokens (single month): we show burst + autoscale cost of $205k (short-term spike costs).

Line items included in the spreadsheet: model compute, GPU-reserved amortized, persistent KV/embeddings storage, request/response egress, support tier, and a conservative 10% buffer. We also included a simple sensitivity table for target $/1M between $500–$1,200 so you can see where reserved vs on-demand flips.

Recommendations:
1) If you can commit to a 12-month reserved profile at ~50M/mo, you’ll land near $750/1M which keeps you under the $1,000 target and gives headroom as usage grows.
2) For production-sensitive flows where latency and SLA matter (payments-critical), we recommend Dedicated for the core path and Hosted fallback for long-tail queries — the model shows that mix reduces tail spend by ~12% relative to pure Hosted in high-volume scenarios.
3) We can provide a SOC2 addendum and outline VPC peering cost impact (roughly +10–15% on top of compute depending on config); Marissa will add that as a line item in v2.

Next steps: please review the attached spreadsheet and let me know which commit tier you want modeled (50M, 100M, 150M). If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min walk-through with Marissa to step through the assumptions.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0134

Attachments: novapay-cost-model-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), novapay-invoice-estimate.pdf (pdf), redwood-pricing-calculator.csv (csv)
